meta.title: Bivio User Knowledge Quiz
meta.description: Multiple-choice questions about everyday Bivio operations, based on the Bivio user manual and internal workflow documentation.
meta.answerFormat: answer is the 0-based index into the options array

questions.question: What determines which screens and actions are available to you in Bivio?
options: Your company configuration and your assigned role
Your browser type and screen size
The time of day and your physical location
Your subscription price and device model
questions.explanation: Your company configuration and role determine which screens and actions appear.

questions.question: How do you sign in to Quick View (waiter PIN login)?
questions.explanation: Quick View uses a company code plus a 4-digit PIN entered on the on-screen keypad.

questions.question: What are the training credentials for exploring Quick View in the demo company?
questions.explanation: The manual documents company code 'demo' and PIN '8520' as training credentials only.

questions.question: What should you check first after signing in?
options: The company name shown on the dashboard
questions.explanation: Check the company shown on the dashboard; ask your administrator if it is wrong.

questions.question: When is it appropriate to use 'Remember me' at sign-in?
options: Only on a device you control
questions.explanation: Only use Remember me on a device you control; log out after your shift on shared devices.

questions.question: What should you do if Bivio reports that access has expired?
options: Retry the payment until it succeeds
Create a new order to refresh the session
Contact your vendor or company administrator
questions.explanation: Retrying a payment or order will not renew access; contact the vendor or administrator.

questions.question: What happens when you clear a notification in Bivio?
options: The related bill is paid automatically
Only the reminder is removed; the operational record still needs attention
questions.explanation: Clearing a notification does not pay a bill, approve an LPO or resolve low stock.

questions.question: How do you open the full list behind a dashboard activity panel?
questions.explanation: Dashboard activity panels provide a View All action that opens the full module.

questions.question: Which paper setup is correct for receipts versus reports?
options: 80 mm for receipts, A4 for reports
A4 for receipts, 80 mm for reports
questions.explanation: The receipt template uses 80 mm paper; reports and the manual are A4.

questions.question: Is Bivio documented as an offline point-of-sale system?
options: Yes, orders queue offline and sync later
No; verify saved records after a connection interruption
Yes, but only in Quick Mode
questions.explanation: Bivio is not documented as an offline POS; verify saved records after a connection interruption.

questions.question: What must happen to an order before it can be turned into a bill?
questions.explanation: Only closed/approved orders are eligible for billing; saving an Open order is not enough.

questions.question: Where should a request such as 'no ice' be recorded on an order?
options: In the order note at the top of the form
In the item note on the product row
questions.explanation: Use the Item note field on the individual product row for preparation requests.

questions.question: Which two selections start a standard staff order?
questions.explanation: The standard order form starts by selecting the waiter and the table.

questions.question: What is the difference between a product and an item in Bivio?
options: A product is what you sell; an item is what you stock
They are the same record with different labels
An item is what you sell; a product is what you stock
Products exist only in Quick Mode
questions.explanation: A product is sold to customers; an item is held in inventory.

questions.question: On which form do you select a Client / customer?
questions.explanation: The Client selector is on the bill form, not on the order screen.

questions.question: How is a bill Discount applied in this build?
options: As a monetary amount in the selected currency, subtracted from the subtotal
As a tip collected for staff
questions.explanation: The discount is a monetary amount in the selected currency and is subtracted from the subtotal.

questions.question: Does a tip reduce the outstanding balance of a bill?
options: No, it is entered separately and does not reduce the bill balance
Yes, but only for card payments
Yes, but only if it exceeds the bill amount
questions.explanation: Tips are entered in Tip Amount separately and do not reduce the bill balance.

questions.question: A payment request times out. What should you do first?
options: Retry the payment immediately several times
Check the bill and payment history before retrying
Close the browser and reopen Bivio
questions.explanation: Check payment history first so that money is not recorded twice.

questions.question: Which orders appear under 'Approved Orders' in the bill form?
questions.explanation: The bill form lists eligible closed/approved orders under Approved Orders.

questions.question: How does the current menu editor handle 'Custom' repetition?
options: It allows multiple weekdays to be selected
It uses a single-day choice under 'Repeat on'
It repeats for the whole month
questions.explanation: The current editor supports a single weekday choice for Custom repetition.

questions.question: When an item runs low on stock, is it automatically hidden from menus?
options: No; review the menu and inventory separately
Yes, but only in Quick Mode
questions.explanation: Do not assume an item is hidden when stock runs low; check menu and inventory separately.

questions.question: Which guest orders can be claimed with 'Claim guest order'?
options: Only unclaimed, open guest orders, with order-edit permission
Only bills that are already paid
questions.explanation: Only unclaimed open guest orders show the action, and claiming requires order-edit permission.

questions.question: Do guests need a staff account to place an order through a table QR menu?
options: Yes, they sign in with a waiter PIN
No, it is a system-generated order source, not a staff account
Yes, they use their client account
questions.explanation: Guest QR is a system-generated order source; guests do not sign in with staff credentials.

questions.question: One carton contains 24 bottles and the recipe unit is Bottle. What is the wholesale-to-recipe factor?
questions.explanation: If one carton contains 24 bottles and the recipe unit is Bottle, the factor is 24.

questions.question: What happens when you open an item record and save it without other actions?
options: An opening stock balance is created
The setup is saved, but no opening stock balance is entered
questions.explanation: Opening an item record does not enter an opening stock balance.

questions.question: What does an LPO status of 'Approved' mean?
options: The request is approved and awaiting purchase
questions.explanation: Approved means approved and awaiting purchase; it does not mean goods were received.

questions.question: What is the difference between a purchase and a delivery?
options: A purchase records supplier/cost; a delivery records actual receipt
A delivery happens before a purchase
questions.explanation: Purchases record what was bought from which supplier; deliveries record what actually arrived.

questions.question: Only part of an ordered quantity arrived. What should you enter on the delivery?
questions.explanation: Enter the quantity actually received and check the line and unit before saving.

questions.question: What is the correct order of the requisition workflow?
questions.explanation: A department requests stock, it is approved, then the storekeeper issues it to the department.

questions.question: On which requisitions is 'Create LPO for remaining items' available?
questions.explanation: The action groups remaining quantities from approved or partially issued requisitions.

questions.question: In a stock taking, what happens to entered counts when you switch the category filter?
options: The stock taking is posted automatically
questions.explanation: Switching categories keeps entered counts; Clear All resets filters and pagination, not quantities.

questions.question: What is the most likely reason a stock taking cannot be posted?
options: Variance remarks are missing on some lines
questions.explanation: Posting requires remarks/reasons for every variance line.

questions.question: What does 'Print Sheet' produce during a stock taking?
options: A full inventory count sheet regardless of the editor's category filter
Only items that have already been counted
questions.explanation: The print sheet is the full inventory count sheet; the editor's category filter does not limit it.

questions.question: What should accompany a stock adjustment?
options: Remarks explaining the correction, such as damage or expiry
questions.explanation: Adjustments should be explained with remarks such as damage, expiry, waste or physical correction.

questions.question: What does the ledger summary's 'Total Stock Value' currently represent?
options: A sum of stock quantities, not money
questions.explanation: The ledger summary currently sums stock quantities, not money; do not use it as a financial valuation.

questions.question: With 25 tots per bottle, a count of 1 bottle and 20 tots equals how many bottles?
questions.explanation: 1 + (20 / 25) = 1.80 bottles, using the configured conversion factors.

questions.question: Can you post only part of an unfinished stock-taking batch?
options: Yes, from the All batches view
No, a batch must be fully counted before it can be posted
Yes, but only in the Legacy workflow
questions.explanation: A batch must be fully counted before posting; the API does not post a subset of an unfinished batch.

questions.question: How does 'Recount selected items' differ from reopening a Ready batch?
options: Recount clears saved counts/reasons and captures fresh references; reopen preserves the original reference
Recount is only available for posted batches
questions.explanation: Recount explicitly clears counts and reasons and gets fresh references; reopening a Ready batch fixes a typo while preserving the reference.

questions.question: When a stock-taking session is closed, what does completion cover?
options: Only the items selected for that session
questions.explanation: Completion covers selected items, not the entire company inventory.

questions.question: How do you produce a sales report for yesterday?
options: Open today's report and subtract it
Set yesterday as both the start and end date in the relevant sales report
questions.explanation: For yesterday's sales, select yesterday as both start and end date in the relevant sales report.

questions.question: Which report would you use to check current item quantities?
questions.explanation: A current-stock report is not a historical sales report; use Stock Statement and related inventory reports.

questions.question: Which export controls may be available on a report?
options: Download Excel and Print PDF, where shown
questions.explanation: Reports expose controls such as Download Excel and Print PDF where available.

questions.question: What should you avoid doing with revenue data in different currencies?
questions.explanation: Use the chart period controls; do not add different currencies together.

questions.question: Which set of reports is NOT included in the active navigation of this build?
options: Expenses, User Activity and Inventory Valuation
questions.explanation: No standalone Expenses, User Activity or Inventory Valuation report is in the active navigation.

questions.question: What does suspending a user block?
options: Sign-in, waiter PIN use and existing sessions
Nothing; it only changes a label
questions.explanation: A suspended account cannot sign in, use a waiter PIN or continue an existing session.

questions.question: Where do you find suspended users in the Users list?
options: They are shown in the default active list
Use the 'Suspended' status filter; they are hidden from the active list
They are deleted from the list
questions.explanation: Suspended users are hidden by default; the Suspended status filter reveals them.

questions.question: Who is affected when a role's permissions are changed?
options: Only the user you are currently editing
questions.explanation: A permission change can affect every user with that role.

questions.question: Which are the four department types in Bivio?
questions.explanation: Department types are Admin, Consumption, Production and Service.

questions.question: Which fields does a product category form contain in this build?
questions.explanation: The product category form contains only Name; the department is set on the product itself. Item categories use a group and departments.

questions.question: What image types and size limit apply when uploading a company logo?
options: PNG, JPG, JPEG or WEBP, up to 1 MB
Any image format, up to 10 MB
SVG only, with no size limit
questions.explanation: Upload a PNG, JPG, JPEG or WEBP image no larger than 1 MB.

questions.question: What must be true of a destination company before setup can be cloned into it?
options: It must already have a full setup
It must have no existing setup
questions.explanation: Setup is copied only when the destination company has no existing setup.

questions.question: What does applying a Starter Catalog create?
options: Setup records such as categories, items, products and prices
questions.explanation: Starter Catalog creates setup records, not opening stock or sales transactions.

questions.question: Should a super-admin account be used for routine cashier work?
options: No; use a role with only the required privileges
Yes, but only in Quick Mode
Only when the printer is offline
questions.explanation: Do not use a super-admin account for routine cashier work.

questions.question: How do PIN sessions affect the password-change prompt in Quick Mode?
options: They must change their password before taking orders
They bypass password-change prompts and cannot open the change-password page
They are logged out every hour
They require email sign-in for every order
questions.explanation: PIN sessions bypass password-change prompts and cannot open the change-password page.

questions.question: What is true about a Quick Mode order draft?
options: It is an offline submission queue
It is saved locally per company and user and survives reloads
It is deleted on every reload
It is shared with all waiters in the company
questions.explanation: Drafts are saved locally per company and user, survive reloads, but are not an offline submission queue.

questions.question: Which bills can a waiter see in Quick Mode?
questions.explanation: Waiters see only their own bills; other accounts see all bills only with bill-view access.

questions.question: Which payment shortcuts are available in Quick Mode?
options: Full, half or quarter of the balance
questions.explanation: Quick Mode records a full, half or quarter-balance payment after choosing a payment mode.

questions.question: Which items appear in the Quick Mode Store section?
options: Only items linked from the selected department's item categories
questions.explanation: Store shows retail-unit quantities from item categories linked to the chosen department; unlinked items are hidden.

questions.question: What happens in Quick Mode when a product has no price in the selected currency?
options: The price is assumed to be zero
It is converted using the latest exchange rate automatically
It is labelled as missing and prevents creating a quick bill in that currency
The product is hidden from the menu
questions.explanation: Missing prices are labelled and block creating a quick bill in that currency.

questions.question: A product is not visible in a list. What should you check first?
options: Add a new product with the same name
Clear filters and check price, category and menu inclusion
questions.explanation: Search/category/menu filters often limit the list; clear filters and check the product setup.

questions.question: Why can't you select an order when creating a bill?
options: The order is still Open or otherwise not eligible; close it first
questions.explanation: The bill form lists eligible closed/approved orders; an Open order is not selectable.

questions.question: A guest QR order has no assigned waiter. What should you do?
options: Use 'Claim guest order' with an authorized account
Create a new bill without an order
questions.explanation: An unclaimed open guest order can be claimed with order-edit permission.

questions.question: A save request times out. What is the safest next step?
options: Search for the record before trying again
Close the browser tab without checking
questions.explanation: A timeout may mean the record was saved; search for it before retrying to avoid duplicates.

questions.question: Why might a button in Bivio be disabled?
options: Your role or the record's status does not allow the action
questions.explanation: A button may be hidden or disabled when your role or the record status does not allow the action.
